newsitem.title: UK: UK drug shares weaken on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: UK drug shares weaken on profit-taking.

text.p: Profit-taking pushed UK drug stocks lower on Wednesday as investors cashed in on recent gains, traders said.
By early afternoon Zeneca shares had slipped 23-1/2p to 16.27 stg and SmithKline Beecham 12p to 803-1/2p.
Glaxo Wellcome, subject of a downgrading to "hold" from "outperform" by Lehman Brothers, was 23p lower at 998p.
All three stocks are within a couple of percentage points of all-time highs.
"The UK drug sector has had a fantastic performance over the last three months," said one trader.
"We saw some profit taking in New York overnight and a little bit more in London this morning."
